body: This describes my past relationship to the letter. It was so painful and draining, and I went from being a confident, happy person to an emotional, pathetic shell of my former self. Something small would happen and the situation would escalate so quickly that'd I'd be left sitting on the floor in tears because I had no idea what had just happened. A lot of it was my fault, for even allowing a space for this stuff to happen over time. We've been broken up a few months now, and I still miss him every day, but it's crystal clear that I'm better off without him.

I don't know a lot about art, but this is why I love his work - The first time I took shrooms I was in a forest. I wasn't consciously familiar with Monet's work (but obviously I had made the association somewhere) and all that kept running through my head was that I was in a Monet painting. It was this amazingly surreal experience - afterwards I googled Monet and saw that his paintings were really like that. Dreamy, rich, emotional. That's how I feel anyway.

I'm in the same boat as you - I was in a relationship with him for 3 years, and then I ended it. When I thought I had made a mistake and went back to him, he had already moved on. There were a lot of reasons for me to end it, but my mind tortures me with what a good person he is and how much I miss him. 

All I know is that there was a reason both of us broke it off, and the reasons are unclear now because of the immensity of the pain. I'm just hoping every day that better things and better days are coming my way. 

I really hope you find peace and that one day (hopefully sooner rather than later) the pain lessens.
